Republic of lhe Philippines DEPARTMF.VI' OF INTERIOR ANI) LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold ('onclonlinium II Bldg. EDSA corner Mapagmahal Street, l)iliman, Quezon City DILG OPINION NO. 108 S. 2010 MAYOR ESTEBAN M. COSCOLLUELA Murcia, Negros Occidental Dear Mayor Coscolluela: This has reference to your letter dated June 15, 2010 asking this Department's legal opinion regarding the validity of Resolution No. 2010-036 passed by the Sangguniang Bayan of Murcia, Negros Occidental. As you represented, on March 31, 2010, the Sangguniang Bayan of Murcia passed Resolution No. 2010-036. The said resolution approved and adopted the Municipal Development Council Resolution No. 10-002, Series of 2010, which approved the supplemental Annual Investment Plan (AIP) cy 2009. On April 12, 2010, Resolution No. 2010-036 was forwarded to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Negros Occidental for review. However, 30 days had already lapsed and the Sangguniang Panlalawigan has not acted upon such resolution. Thus, you are now seeking confirmation from this Department on whether or not Resolution No. 2010-036 can now be presumed consistent with law and therefore valid, in accordance with Section 56(d) of the Local Government Code of 1991. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered the same query in DILG Opinion No. 16, series of 2009. In the said legal opinion, we opined that the phrase "take action" on the part of the Sanggunian within the prescribed period fixed by law, as provided for in Section 56(d) of the Local Government Code, should be construed as either approval or disapproval of the ordinance and not just any other action of the reviewing Sanggunian, such as referrals to committee, etc. After the lapse of the 30 day period, and no official and/or formal documents, such as a resolution containing the findings of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan on the review of the municipal ordinance or resolution, was issued by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, it can be validly stated that the Sangguniang Panlalawigan failed to act within thirty (30) days and the ordinance or resolution under review can be presumed consistent with law and therefore valid.

Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: ATT . JESU B.D QUE IV Director III Leg 1:03/Merle
